# Deletion test names describe the selection and thread shape

This harness is browser_deletionFromThreads.js. Newer tasks in the inspected file use descriptive test_ names for an expanded root, child, or collapsed-thread selection, while older delete_from_ tasks remain. The verification helper uses verify_message_read_status. Scoped naming recommendation: preserve the directory harness form and name the message/thread scenario; these mixed task forms do not justify a project-wide camel-case or underscore-only rule. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: folder display deletion test naming.
